svg.title: Full pipeline: user query to Save to Wiki
svg.desc: Flowchart showing every step from user typing a search query through paper discovery, fetch, parse, reading view, highlight, and Save to Wiki.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the search input UI look like?')
sendPrompt('How does Tavily work for paper search?')
sendPrompt('What does the arXiv API return?')
sendPrompt('How does deduplication and ranking work?')
sendPrompt('What does the paper results list look like?')
sendPrompt('How is an open-access paper fetched?')
sendPrompt('What does the reading view look like?')
sendPrompt('How does the sidebar chat use enriched context?')
sendPrompt('What does the Save to Wiki popup look like?')
sendPrompt('What does the LLM completion pass do when saving?')
sendPrompt('What does a saved wiki node look like?')
